architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events. Within a capability, services communicate freely.

consumed_events.name: CreditAssessmentCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-027: Receive credit assessment outcome. If approved: create LoanOffer and present to customer. If referred: route to manual review. If declined: record decline reason.
consumed_events.maps_to: LoanApplication: approval_decision, credit_score, risk_band, approved_apr, monthly_repayment

consumed_events.name: LoanApplicationSubmitted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-027: Trigger credit assessment. Run credit bureau check, DTI calculation, affordability stress test. Publish CreditAssessmentCompleted.
consumed_events.maps_to: Credit assessment inputs: loan_amount, term_months, gross_monthly_income, monthly_committed_expenditure, customer_id for bureau lookup

design_decisions.decision: Credit assessment is triggered by consuming LoanApplicationSubmitted event — SVC-012 does not expose a synchronous API for credit assessment to SVC-001.
design_decisions.rationale: Cross-capability communication must be async events. Credit assessment may take up to 30 seconds — an async pattern prevents SVC-001 from blocking on the assessment.

consumed_events.name: LoanApplicationSubmitted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-027: AML monitoring for loan origination — check for structuring risk, suspicious loan purpose patterns.
consumed_events.maps_to: AML monitoring record: loan_amount, purpose flagged for transaction monitoring

consumed_events.name: LoanAgreementExecuted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-027: Record consumer credit agreement for CONC regulatory reporting. Update consumer credit register.
consumed_events.maps_to: Regulatory reporting dataset: new consumer credit agreement, APR, loan_amount, customer_id

consumed_events.name: LoanAgreementExecuted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-027: Initiate loan drawdown payment to customer's nominated account. Internal transfer or FPS.

consumed_events.name: LoanDrawdownCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-027: Dispatch disbursement confirmation to customer.

consumed_events.name: LoanAgreementExecuted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-027: Write immutable audit record of consumer credit agreement execution.

consumed_events.name: LoanDrawdownCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-027: Write immutable audit record of loan disbursement.

cross_service_interaction_summary.purpose: Trigger credit assessment in Risk Management capability
Return credit assessment result to Retail Banking
